## Summary

Free no-signup, no-tracking, browser-only calculator for SaaS trial-to-paid conversion sample-size planning. It estimates A/B test enrollment needs, expected paid conversions, readout timing after trial lag, and single-rate estimate sample size within a selected margin of error.

## Pages

- [Trial-to-Paid Conversion Sample Size Calculator](https://trial-to-paid-conversion-sample-size-calculator.vercel.app/): Main browser worksheet with Markdown and CSV exports.

## Runtime And Privacy

- Runs fully in the browser.
- No cookies, analytics, uploads, external scripts, browser storage, or runtime network calls.
- Exports are generated locally.

## Boundaries

Statistical planning worksheet only. Not legal, financial, tax, accounting, investment, or growth advice.
